statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-43869 affects Apache Thrift libthrift 0.16.0 used by Spark 4.0.x and 4.1.x. The vulnerability involves improper validation of certificates with host mismatch. The fix is available in libthrift 0.23.0, but Spark has a hardcoded dependency on libthrift 0.16.0. Upgrading from 0.16.0 to 0.23.0 represents a major version jump that would require extensive testing and validation by Apache Spark upstream to ensure compatibility with Spark's Thrift-based RPC communication layer used for distributed computing.

CVE-2026-43869 affects Apache Thrift libthrift 0.16.0 used by Spark 4.0.x and 4.1.x. The vulnerability involves improper validation of certificates with host mismatch. The fix is available in libthrift 0.23.0, but Spark has a hardcoded dependency on libthrift 0.16.0. Upgrading from 0.16.0 to 0.23.0 represents a major version jump that would require extensive testing and validation by Apache Spark upstream to ensure compatibility with Spark's Thrift-based RPC communication layer used for distributed computing.

No upstream fix is available: the advisory lists every libthrift release up to and including 0.22.0 as affected with no fixed version. libthrift@0.9.3 is shaded inside druid-iceberg-extensions and druid-ranger-security; libthrift@0.13.0 is bundled by druid-thrift-extensions. Remediation requires upstream Apache Thrift to ship a fix and the consuming Druid/Ranger components to repin. Monitor apache/thrift, apache/druid, and apache/ranger upstream.

libthrift@0.9.3 is shaded inside the druid-ranger-security extension fat-JAR via ranger-plugins-common. CVE-2019-0210 describes a Go server panic - Druid is a Java application with no Go server component, so the vulnerable code path is not exercisable. Fix requires upstream Apache Ranger to update its bundled libthrift to >= 0.13.0. Monitor apache/ranger upstream.
